prompt:
Generate ONE NEW standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration, revising the earlier personal-IP 'mutual cost of trade conflict' concept. Image 1 is the IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the same young adult man, black tousled short hair with a small bent upward tuft, muted jade-green open overshirt with casually rolled sleeves, completely plain white T-shirt, charcoal-black above-knee shorts, white socks, off-white athletic shoes with tiny pale yellow accents. Image 2 is the STYLE / VISUAL HIERARCHY AND SCENE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its spare ink economy, small working characters relative to oversized props, visual focus on shared beam and falling parcels, NOT its black bean characters. All actual characters must be the HUMAN green-shirt personal IP from image 1. Do not include any black monster.

Specific improvements: The human figures must be substantially SMALLER than in a portrait-led illustration, each only about 28-33% of total canvas height. Preserve an elegant youthful ADULT silhouette, modestly enlarged cartoon head, NOT chibi. Flat limited jade/white/black colors, no skin shadows, rosy cheeks, fabric shading or gradients. Hair is one black silhouette with a few edge tufts, no strands. Tiny black eyes, very short eyebrow and mouth strokes, quiet serious attention to the task, NOT anime eyes, grinning, screaming or fashionable upward gaze. Shirts have at most 2-3 fold strokes each, shorts simple flat shape, shoes have only a simple outline and one small pale-yellow panel, NO drawn shoelaces or logo. Slightly wobbly BLACK ink contours for BOTH people and props at similar line weight. Neither a polished anime figure pasted onto a sketch nor an outlined vector mascot.

Scene: Two instances of this SAME green-shirt human stand at opposite ends of ONE long narrow white outlined wooden seesaw beam resting on ONE simple triangular central fulcrum. BOTH feet of EACH person rest visibly ON THE BEAM, knees modestly bent, leaning away from center in balanced tugging poses. They pull opposite ends of ONE clearly CONTINUOUS taut black rope with both hands; eyes look along the rope toward the task, no disconnected rope segments and no text covering the rope. Keep the contact points clear and anatomy simple. The plank is large relative to the small workers. At the center ONE single obvious crack forms immediately beside the fulcrum. TWO white black-outline trade parcel boxes are beginning to tip at the crack, and ONE third box is visibly falling just below the crack. Emphasize THIS fragile support and falling parcel as the narrative focal point; not the characters' faces. Three parcels total. One very small red mark near crack, a short red directional annotation from consequence label toward crack. Do not turn plank into two unrelated beams or draw multiple random breaks. No scenery or ground line.

Exact short handwritten Chinese annotations, clearly legible: '较劲' in restrained ORANGE above the taut rope without interrupting it; '生意' in restrained BLUE beside the center parcels, with a short leader; '代价' in RED adjacent to crack/falling box. No additional text, no top-left title, no caption or panel frames.

Composition: airy central wide arrangement, keep full figures and all props visible within margins. Upper and lower canvas have generous untouched PURE WHITE breathing room, at least 40% white negative space. Objects entirely white inside black outlines, no gray fill, paper texture, cast shadows or perspective-rendering. The humor comes from two focused workers straining their shared support, not from exaggerated facial expressions. A concise thoughtful hand-drawn explanatory sketch where mechanism reads first and personal identity reads second.
